<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy Focus:</strong> The Monetary Policy Committee has commenced a three-day meeting, with economists and market participants largely expecting a 25 bps repo rate hike—the first since 2023—to address persistent inflation and rising crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Performance:</strong> Indian equity indices saw a rebound with the Sensex gaining over 700 points in early trade, providing a brief respite following a prolonged period of volatility and FII outflows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I63</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I59</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Bond Market Dynamics:</strong> The Indian bond yield curve is expected to flatten as the RBI moves to drain surplus liquidity, with investors closely monitoring the 10-year debt segment ahead of the policy outcome.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I47</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I48</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>External Pressures:</strong> Global headwinds, including elevated crude oil prices near $100 per barrel and rising US bond yields, are significantly influencing the domestic policy environment and investor sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
</ul>
